description: This file defines the DefaultBlobContainerFactory class, which implements IBlobContainerFactory to create and initialize Azure Blob Storage containers for Orleans grains, using specified options.

classes.name: DefaultBlobContainerFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and initializing Azure Blob Storage containers with default container name, used within Orleans grain storage.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the BlobContainerClient by creating the container if it does not exist, using the provided BlobServiceClient and cancellation token.
